records.title: VLM2Rec: Resolving Modality Collapse in Vision-Language Model Embedders for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
records.reason: Multimodal sequential recommendation embedding optimization; it targets recommendation accuracy, not LLM inference efficiency or an identified target lineage.

records.title: TENSO: Software Package for Numerically Exact Open Quantum Dynamics Based on Efficient Tree Tensor Network Decomposition of the Hierarchical Equations of Motion
records.reason: TENSO uses tree-tensor-network HEOM propagation to control quantum-dynamics simulation cost and demonstrates chemistry/physics examples. Its resource section notes stiff equations can require tiny steps and runtime depends on the system. The full paper is an open-quantum-systems software package, with no language-model or serving connection.

records.title: An Empirical Investigation of Pre-Trained Deep Learning Model Reuse in the Scientific Process
records.reason: The paper empirically analyzes pretrained model reuse across 17,718 natural-science papers and reports adaptation/testing as common patterns. It is a literature study, not an inference optimization; external validity is limited by selected journals and field distribution.

records.title: The Discrete Charm of the MLP: Binary Routing of Continuous Signals in Transformer Feed-Forward Layers
records.reason: The paper analyzes binary routing behavior in GPT-2 MLP activations and validates functional importance via ablations/perplexity. It proposes a characterization, not a routing optimization or measured serving/compute savings; it is only an indirect possible connection to conditional compute.

records.title: Task-Conditioned Routing Signatures in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
records.reason: The work introduces prompt-level MoE routing signatures and evaluates task-category separability/classification on OLMoE. It studies routing telemetry rather than changing routing or demonstrating inference cost gains, so the MoE serving connection is weak.
